definitions: A substance used to stimulate the production of antibodies and provide immunity against one or several diseases, prepared from the causative agent of a disease, its products, or a synthetic substitute, treated to act as an antigen without inducing the disease.
examples: The new vaccine offers protection against several strains of the virus.
Children receive a series of vaccines during their early years.
The development of a malaria vaccine is a global health priority.
The vaccine was administered by a nurse.
The vaccine programme has been very successful.
